meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **shaadi ke liye budget online sarees** kharidni hain to sabse practical options woh hain jahan **starting prices low** hon aur collection wedding-appropriate ho. Search results ke hisaab se **Meesho** par wedding sarees **₹149 se** mil rahi hain, aur kai options **₹299 se kam** bhi listed hain, isliye *ultra-budget* ke liye yeh sabse sasta option dikh raha hai.[1]

Agar aap thoda better fabric aur look chahte hain, to yeh options zyada useful rahenge:

- **Meesho**: sabse low budget, wedding saree collection with prices from **₹149**.[1]
- **Myntra**: budget-friendly everyday-to-occasion sarees; search result me **sarees below ₹500 / below ₹1000** jaise price filters dikh rahe hain.[12]
- **Manyavar Mohey**: wedding/occasion sarees **₹1,499** se start ho rahi hain, aur **organza, chiffon, Banarasi** styles bhi listed hain.[19]
- **Amrut Fashion**: wedding sarees me **sale price ₹2,499** jaisi options mil rahi hain.[9]
- **Libas**: wedding sarees collection me ek listing **₹1,139** ki dikh rahi hai.[3]
- **Mohi Fashion**: budget-friendly bridal sarees aur regional styles jaise **leheriya** aur **paithani** highlight kiye gaye hain.[4]
- **Sudathi**: budget-conscious wedding sarees ke liye “without overspending” positioning ke saath collection hai.[6]

Agar aap **shaadi mein pehnne layak, budget + classy** saree chahte hain, to main yeh shortlist recommend karunga:

| Budget | Best types | Where to look |
|---|---|---|
| **₹500 ke andar** | Simple georgette, printed, lightweight sarees | Meesho, Myntra[1][12] |
| **₹1,000–₹3,000** | Organza, chiffon, simple silk-blend, light embroidery | Libas, Manyavar Mohey, Amrut Fashion[3][9][19] |
| **₹3,000–₹7,000** | Better occasion wear, Banarasi look, zari work | Manyavar Mohey, Libas, Mohi Fashion[3][4][19] |
| **₹7,000+** | Heavier wedding/silk options | Nalli, Kankatala, Kalki, KanchiVML[5][7][8][13] |

**Quick buying tip:**  
- **Guest/haldi/mehendi** ke liye printed georgette, chiffon, ya organza lo.[12][19]  
- **Wedding function** ke liye silk-blend, Banarasi, ya light zari work choose karo.[3][8][19]  
- **Bride** ke liye agar budget tight hai to Nalli, Kanchivml, ya Kalki ke entry-level wedding sarees dekh sakte ho, lekin inme prices kaafi higher range se start hote hain.[5][8][13]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 5 best saree options shortlist kar doon — jaise **₹1000**, **₹2000**, ya **₹5000** ke andar.
